name: Local or mounted file system
description: A folder on a local or mounted file system (including network shares and synced OneDrive / SharePoint folders). Folders that hold matching files are containers, files are datasets, and fields are inferred from CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines, Avro and (Python, parquet extra) Parquet content.
